prompt:
Image 1 is the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge of a room. Edit it into the same view of the same room at this time of day: Night. Keep the camera position, framing, lens, walls, doors, windows, furniture, materials and colours exactly as in Image 1; change only the light. Outside every window and doorway, show what that place looks like at Night, with the sky, light and lit windows of that time, never the daylight scene of Image 1 darkened. Inside, light the room as the description says it is lit at that time, with only the lamps it names turned on. The place stays completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette or reflection of a person anywhere. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room. The living room of a small but bright, clean and stylish present-day one-bedroom downtown apartment, with white walls, a pale oak floor and warm modern-minimalist décor. Back wall: on its left half, a large floor-to-ceiling window with sheer linen curtains looking out over the city skyline; by day, sunlight streams in through it from behind, and by night the city lights glow through it. On the right half of the back wall is the white panelled bedroom door, the only bedroom. Left wall: the apartment's front door, a dark-grey panelled door with a brass handle, which is the way in, with wall hooks and a slim oak shoe bench beside it. Right wall: a compact open kitchenette with white flat-front cabinets, a pale stone counter and two oak stools tucked under the counter's overhang. Front wall (behind the camera): low oak bookshelves. A charcoal-grey linen three-seat couch stands in the middle of the room, slightly left of centre, its back to the camera, facing the back wall's window, with a brass arc floor lamp at its left end and a low round oak coffee table in front of it. A small round light-oak dining table with two upholstered chairs stands in the right half of the room, between the couch and the kitchenette, nearer the bedroom door. A glass globe pendant lamp hangs over the dining table. At night the warm floor lamp from the left and the pendant over the table are the light sources; by day the window on the back wall gives soft, bright light.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, a darkened copy of Image 1's daylight, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
